connector.name: Robokassa MCP by artgas1
connector.registryDescription: Comprehensive MCP server for the Robokassa payment gateway (18 tools, full API coverage).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package robokassa-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the artgas1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ROBOKASSA_LOGIN
env.description: Merchant login identifier for the Robokassa shop.

env.name: ROBOKASSA_PASSWORD1
env.description: Shop's Password #1 — used for checkout URL signing, SuccessURL signature verification, CalcOutSumm, fiscal receipts, and SMS.

env.name: ROBOKASSA_PASSWORD2
env.description: Shop's Password #2 — used for OpStateExt payment status checks and ResultURL signature verification.

env.name: ROBOKASSA_PASSWORD3
env.description: Shop's Password #3 — used for Refund API (JWT HS256). Refund API access must be enabled in the cabinet.
